action.desc: The addition, update, or deletion action that was taken on the data field.
action.name: Action

createdbyagent.desc: A foreign key link to the Agent table and to the name of the logged-in user who made a change.
createdbyagent.name: Created By Agent

fields.desc: The SpAuditlogField records associated with the change.
fields.name: Fields

modifiedbyagent.desc: This is the same data as in the CreatedByAgent field.
modifiedbyagent.name: Modified By Agent

parentrecordid.desc: The unique record ID of the record in the parent table to which the changed record is linked.
parentrecordid.name: Parent Record Id

parenttablenum.desc: The number ID or name of the parent table of the record that has been modified.  For example if the changed record is in the Collection Object table, this value points to the 'Collection' table.
parenttablenum.name: Parent Table Num

recordid.desc: The unique record ID of the record that was created, changed, or deleted.
recordid.name: Record Id

recordversion.desc: The internal number used by Hibernate within Specify to keep track of the version of the changed record.
recordversion.name: Record Version

tablenum.desc: The table of the new, changed, or deleted record.
tablenum.name: Table Num

timestampcreated.desc: The date and time the record change, addition, or deletion was made.
timestampcreated.name: Timestamp Created

timestampmodified.desc: Same information as the TimestampCreated field.
timestampmodified.name: Timestamp Modified

version.desc: Internal number, always = 0. No reporting value.
version.name: Version
